Lower #17 lead joins the lower unnumbered 7C6 diode glyph lead and descends to the AVC rail; its crossing of the passive B− return has no junction dot.

Lower #7 lead joins the lower #2 secondary lead and AVC rail.
Upper #8 lead joins the main B− rail at the converter cathode return.
Lower #8 lead joins the lower #2 secondary lead and AVC rail.
Lower #15 lead has an explicit dot on the same B− rail as #19:b and the 7C6 cathode.
Lower #16 track end has an explicit dot on that B− rail; the separate switch is unchanged.
Lower #19 lead has an explicit dot on the same B− rail as the 7C6 cathode.
